items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: I picked up from an interview that you did a couple years ago with Dick Allen

ctx.x: Okay, fine. Well, and then I want to relate it back to the music. But, well, let me just mention a few things that I picked up from an interview that you did a couple years ago with Dick Allen and asked you about this. From that interview, I understand that you were a delegate to the Keep America on a War Convention.
And... That was in Washington in 1938.
